reason.pt-BR: Os moldes mostram como os moradores morreram; as paredes, como viviam.
reason.en: The casts show how Pompeii’s people died; the walls show how they lived.

reason.pt-BR: Do muro para o balcão: outro retrato do dia a dia na cidade.
reason.en: From the wall to the counter: another snapshot of daily life in the town.
